newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Consmining buys Randgold shares.
newsitem.headline: Consmining buys Randgold shares.

text.p: Consolidated Mining Corp (Consmining) said on Friday it had bought 6.84 million shares in Randgold & Exploration Co Ltd at an approximate issue price of 3,900 cents each from certain institutions.
Consmining, a mining and finance holding company, said the acqusition emphasises its strategy to enlarge its asset base through appropriate purchases.
Payment will be settled by the issue of some 333.30 million Consmining shares at an issue price of 80 cents each.
Consmining at the same time cautioned that talks, which could affect its share price, were in progress.
